## Overview

The EOS Annual Meeting is the European Optical Society's main conference,
organised in topical meetings. The 2022 edition in Porto included
**TOM7, Thermal radiation and energy management**, chaired by Mauro Antezza
(Université de Montpellier), Marco Centini and Maria Cristina Larciprete
(Sapienza Università di Roma). It covered fundamental and applied aspects of
thermal-radiation management: energy harvesting, mid-infrared thermal
sources, infrared radiation control, radiative cooling, biosensing and
IR and THz spectroscopy. Proceedings appear in EPJ Web of Conferences
volume 266; the programme archive remains online.
